name: Six Flags
outlook:
What Six Flags says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: same-park Adjusted EBITDASix Flags now expects fourth quarter 2026 same-park Adjusted EBITDA (1) to be between $140 and $150 million compared with fourth quarter 2025 same-park Adjusted EBITDA of $167 million.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresSix Flags now expects 2026 capital expenditures of $350.0 million to $375.0 million, compared with its prior expectation of $400.0 million to $425.0 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: operating daysSix Flags currently expects about 60 additional operating days in the fourth quarter versus last year, driven mainly by the return of Holiday in the Park winter events.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
